preconditions.description: The length of the input string is greater than 0 and less than or equal to 10^6.

preconditions.expression: all(char in 'BCDFGHJKLMNPQRSTVWXYZ' for char in string)
preconditions.description: The input string contains only uppercase letters from B to Z.

postconditions.expression: output == 'Stuart ' + str(stuart_score) or output == 'Kevin ' + str(kevin_score) or output == 'Draw'
postconditions.description: The output is the name of the winner and their score, or 'Draw' if there is no winner.
